title: 第一卷 第25章 诛邪刀成路遇秦莱第一卷 第26章 兄弟密谋
slug: 武道长生从猎户开始刷熟练度修行
lines: 秦猛感受着体内澎湃的力量，身体又被增强了不少。
忍不住低喝一声，心神沉入面板，只见原本的“破锋八刀”
子界面已焕然一新。
【诛邪破锋刀·玄阶下品】
【武技，进度：2%】
【诛邪破锋刀-登堂（35200）】
【特效：体魄增强、锋锐】
【特殊状态·诛邪（初显）】
特效·体魄增强：大幅度增强身体素质
特效·锋锐：煞气附刃，锋锐度倍增，对护具有斩穿之能，对实体伤害增幅30%
特殊状态·诛邪：自动凝聚杀伐煞气，可辟除阴邪，镇杀妖魔秽物，对魂体伤害增幅40%。
刀法子界面，武技名称品阶、熟练度、特效等清清楚楚。
刀法段位虽然滑落至精通，可却从‘不入流’跃升至‘玄阶下品’，这个变化毋庸置疑，不仅刀法威力增强了数倍，而且被动增幅有增无减。
秦猛收敛气息，转身走向王敢，脸上露出真诚的笑容，抱拳深深一礼：“多谢老爷子传刀之恩。”
王敢这才从震惊中回过神，苦笑着摆手：“这是你的天资了得……不，这已不是天资能解释的了。
你小子，醒来后开了窍，果然不简单。”
他看向秦猛的眼神复杂无比，有惊叹，有欣慰，有淡淡的嫉妒，是自己孙儿，与之比较后，这种悟性，这种进步速度，简直闻所未闻。
“猛子哥，你真厉害，这刀法我学了三天才记住招式。”
王铁牛也上赞叹，满脸的自愧不如。
他性格憨厚，没有丝毫嫉妒，这让王老头脸颊微红。
“铁牛，天道酬勤，天赋是回事，努力才是根本。”
秦猛拍着王铁牛的肩膀，与爷孙攀谈起来。
王敢索性将一些关外的形势、炎汉王朝与异族的恩怨，以及武道修行中最忌讳的几条规矩，都细细说与秦猛听。
“切记，在入边军之前，绝不可修炼歪门邪道。
军中检测手段繁多，一旦查出问题，轻则就地格杀，重则…重则连累家人，乃至整个村坊。”
王敢说这话时，神色异常严肃：“王朝境内武风盛行，但对邪魔外道，没有丝毫妥协余地。”
秦猛郑重点头：“小子明白。”
日头偏西时，他背上弓刀告辞离开。
先是去堡内木匠家交了定金，订下一套桌椅柜子；又找到相熟的泥瓦匠，约好明日带人去修缮老屋，从匠头老杨家出来，夕阳已西斜。
秦猛背着弓刀走在土路上，心神再次沉入意识深处的面板上，如同往常那样，显示个人信息。
【姓名：秦猛】
【境界：凡体。
【本命天赋：神勇】
【天赋：野性感知-高阶（3%）、环境相融-中阶（11%）、铁背-中阶（3%）、皮糙肉厚-低阶（5%）】
【核心功法：无】
content_en:
"Okay!"
Qin Meng felt the surging power in his body, and his body was strengthened a lot.
I couldn't help but let out a low shout, my mind sank into the panel, and I saw the original "Eight Breaking Blades"
The sub-interface has been given a new look.
[Evil-killing Saber·Xuanjie Lower Grade]
[Martial skills, progress: 2%]
[Evil-killing Blade-Dengtang (35200)]
[Special effects: physical enhancement, sharpness]
[Special Status·Evil Killing (Initial Appearance)]
Special effects·Physical enhancement: greatly enhance physical fitness
Special effects·Sharpness: The evil energy is attached to the blade, the sharpness is doubled, it has the ability to cut through the armor, and the damage to entities is increased by 30%.
Special status·Evil-killing: Automatically condenses the killing evil spirit, which can ward off evil spirits, suppress demons and filth, and increase the damage to the soul by 40%.
The sword technique sub-interface clearly displays the name, level, proficiency, and special effects of the martial arts.
Although the sword skill level has dropped to proficient, it has jumped from 'unqualified' to 'lower grade Xuan level'. This change is unquestionable. Not only has the power of the sword skill increased several times, but the passive increase has continued unabated.
Qin Meng calmed down his breath, turned around and walked towards Wang Gan, with a sincere smile on his face, cupped his fists and gave a deep salute: "Thank you, old man, for passing on the sword."
Wang Gan recovered from the shock and waved his hands with a wry smile: "This is your talent... No, this can no longer be explained by talent.
You kid, you woke up and got enlightened. It’s really not that simple. "
The look he looked at Qin Meng was extremely complicated, with a mixture of wonder, relief, and a hint of jealousy. He was his grandson. Compared with this, this kind of understanding and this kind of speed of progress were simply unheard of.
"Brother Mengzi, you are so powerful. It took me three days to learn this sword technique before I could remember the moves."
Wang Tieniu also came up to praise him, his face full of shame.
He has a simple and honest personality, without any jealousy, which makes Old Wang's cheeks slightly red.
"Tie Niu, God rewards hard work, talent is one thing, hard work is the foundation."
Qin Meng patted Wang Tieniu on the shoulder and started chatting with his grandfather and grandson.
Wang Da dared to tell Qin Meng in detail about the situation outside the customs, the grievances between the Yanhan Dynasty and foreign races, and some of the most taboo rules in martial arts practice.
"Remember, before joining the border army, you must not practice evil ways.
There are many detection methods in the military. Once a problem is found, they will be killed on the spot, or... at worst, their family members or even the entire village will be affected. "
When Wang dared to say this, his expression was extremely serious: "Martial arts are prevalent in the dynasty, but there is no room for compromise against evil spirits and heretics."
Qin Meng nodded solemnly: "I understand, kid."
When the sun turned west, he put his bow and sword on his back and left.
First, he went to the carpenter's house in the fort to pay a deposit and order a set of tables, chairs and cabinets. Then he found a familiar mason and made an appointment to take someone to repair the old house tomorrow. When he left the house of the master craftsman, Old Yang, the sun was already setting in the west.
Qin Meng walked on the dirt road with his bow and knife on his back, his mind sinking into the depths of his consciousness again. The panel displayed personal information as usual.
[Name: Qin Meng]
[Realm: mortal body.
[Natural talent: bravery]
[Talent: Wild Sense - High Level (3%), Environmental Blending - Intermediate Level (11%), Iron Back - Intermediate Level (3%), Rough Skin and Thick Flesh - Low Level (5%)]
[Core Skills: None]
